members.name: calcsize
members.doc: Return size in bytes of the struct described by the format string.

members.name: error
members.doc: Common base class for all non-exit exceptions.

members.name: iter_unpack
members.doc: Return an iterator yielding tuples unpacked from the given bytes. The bytes are unpacked according to the format string, like a repeated invocation of unpack_fr

members.name: pack
members.doc: pack(format, v1, v2, ...) -> bytes Return a bytes object containing the values v1, v2, ... packed according to the format string. See help(struct) for more on f

members.name: pack_into
members.doc: pack_into(format, buffer, offset, v1, v2, ...) Pack the values v1, v2, ... according to the format string and write the packed bytes into the writable buffer bu

members.name: unpack
members.doc: Return a tuple containing values unpacked according to the format string. The buffer's size in bytes must be calcsize(format). See help(struct) for more on form

members.name: unpack_from
members.doc: Return a tuple containing values unpacked according to the format string. The buffer's size, minus offset, must be at least calcsize(format). See help(struct) f
